mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record ( user_id, book_id, borrow_time, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{bookId}, NOW(), #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
SELECT * FROM borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY borrow_time DESC
SELECT * FROM borrow_record ORDER BY borrow_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE borrow_record SET status = 1, return_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE borrow_record SET status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE status = 0 AND borrow_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
